runtimePolicy.unknownValues: null means unresolved; it is not zero or unrestricted.
runtimePolicy.classificationPolicy: Use general gameplay entities when specific species add no meaningful resource or behavior distinction. Scientific taxonomy is optional background, not an unlock or entity identity requirement. Preserve distinctions for crops, wild/domestic forms and other actual gameplay differences.
